project.name: Example Operations Console
project.summary: A long-lived internal console for a small operations team.
project.problem: Operators currently reconcile important work across disconnected spreadsheets.
successCriteria: An operator can complete the daily workflow without editing a spreadsheet

technology.rationale: A typed Web stack fits the interactive workflow while keeping one language across the starter.

assumptions.text: The first internal trial will use synthetic records.

decisions.title: Use the TypeScript and Node adapter
decisions.context: The project needs an interactive internal Web interface and long-term maintenance by an AI-assisted owner.
decisions.choice: Generate the TypeScript and Node foundation.
decisions.rationale: One typed language and mature testing tools reduce maintenance complexity.
alternatives: Use a Python service with a separate browser client
consequences: Node and npm become required local tools
A deployment platform is selected later
decisions.reviewWhen: Review only if the first release requires Python-specific data libraries.
